title: Glessner's 18th Street gable window and its stone fan raised a foot
items: The tall arched window high in the Glessner house's 18th Street gable, with the fan of radiating stones over it, now stands a foot higher, closer under the chimney, as three survey photographs from 1963 and 1965 show it. Before, the chimney seemed to rise too far above the fan.
